TITLE: Asana
UNAVAILABLE: The Asana integration is not loaded on this server (ASANA_ENABLED is off).
NOT_CONFIGURED: The Asana OAuth application is not configured on this server (ASANA_CLIENT_ID, ASANA_CLIENT_SECRET, the callback URL). Nobody can connect until it is.

CONNECT.TITLE: Connect your Asana account
CONNECT.TEXT: You will authorize this platform in Asana and come back here. Then map Asana projects to projects, import their tasks, and keep them in sync.

CALLBACK_ERRORS.not_configured: The Asana OAuth application is not configured on this server.
CALLBACK_ERRORS.denied: Asana did not authorize the connection.
CALLBACK_ERRORS.invalid_state: The connect flow expired or was already used. Start it again.
CALLBACK_ERRORS.exchange_failed: Asana refused the authorization code. Start the flow again.
CALLBACK_ERRORS.user_unreadable: The Asana account could not be read after authorizing.
CALLBACK_ERRORS.not_saved: The connection could not be saved.

REASONS.token_refused: Asana refused the token. Connect again.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Asana settings
SETTINGS.WEBHOOKS_ON: On: Asana sends changes as they happen.
SETTINGS.WEBHOOKS_OFF: Off: this server has no public address for Asana (ASANA_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL); use the imports.
SETTINGS.DISCONNECT_CONFIRM: Disconnect Asana from this organization? The mappings go; the imported tasks stay.

MAPPINGS.TITLE: Asana projects and projects
MAPPINGS.INTRO: Each Asana project maps to one project. Inbound brings the Asana project's tasks in as tasks; outbound sends the project's tasks to Asana (one outbound mapping per project). A completed Asana task is always the completed status; a section can name the status its tasks get.
MAPPINGS.EMPTY: No Asana project is mapped yet.
MAPPINGS.SECTION_MAP_HINT: The task status name a task gets for each section of the Asana project. Leave a section blank to use its name when it is a status, else open.
MAPPINGS.WEBHOOK_REQUESTED: The webhook is being registered; the list refreshes in a moment.
MAPPINGS.REMOVE_CONFIRM: Remove this mapping? The imported tasks stay.
MAPPINGS.IMPORT_STARTED: The import started; see the runs below.
MAPPINGS.NO_PROJECTS: Every project of this workspace is mapped, or it has none.
MAPPINGS.NO_SECTIONS: This Asana project has no section.

RUNS.TITLE: Runs
RUNS.SHOW_CONFLICTS: List the conflicts this run found

CONFLICTS.TITLE: Sync conflicts
CONFLICTS.INTRO: A field changed both in Asana and on the platform since they last agreed. Asana's value was applied to the task, and the task's value is kept here: keep Asana's value, or restore the task's (a mapping that sends changes out sends it to the Asana task too).
CONFLICTS.KEPT_EXTERNAL: Resolved: the task keeps the value it has now.
CONFLICTS.KEPT_PLATFORM: The task's value was written back.

ERRORS.STALE: The task changed since the conflict was found, so its value was not written back. Keep Asana's value, or edit the task.
ERRORS.NOT_FOUND: This conflict was resolved already; the list was read again.
